# DeepSeek Trading Lessons (Auto-generated by xAI review)

This file contains corrections and lessons from Grok-4.3 reviews of DeepSeek decisions.
It is automatically appended to every DeepSeek prompt to prevent repeated mistakes.

## Format
Each lesson is a short few-shot example in this structure:

```json
{
  "situation": "brief description of market state",
  "deepseek_decision": "BUY/SELL/HOLD with confidence",
  "actual_outcome": "what happened in next 15min",
  "correct_action": "what should have been done",
  "lesson": "one-sentence rule to remember"
}
```
